gloss_text: Reliance share reached your target price. Open the app to see details.
Today's market closed 0.4% higher. Your portfolio summary will arrive at 8 pm.
In the last hour Bitcoin rose 5%. Tap if you want to set a price alert.
The stock market opens at 9:15 am today. Read the pre-market news.
A stock you hold dropped 3%. The market says this is normal fluctuation.
This week your crypto holdings rose 1.2%. The full report comes out on Sunday.
Live Caption is turned on. The Tamil language pack finished downloading.
Live captions are paused. Tap here to resume.
Sound notifications are now turned off. Go to settings to turn alarm sounds back on.
Speech recognition now runs in English. Open settings to change the language.
Caption language change complete. Speech now appears as Tamil text.
Live Caption turned off automatically because the battery is low. Charge the phone and turn it back on.

Ramu: Last night a cat had kittens in our building parking lot 😂 / Meena: Yes, I saw them too, very cute. / Karthi: Shall we have a tea party on Saturday? Someone bring snacks. / Meena: Okay, I'll bring biscuits.
Forward this to everyone! Someone said free nutrition tablets will be given to children tomorrow at 6 am. I don't know if it's true. Spread it, let everyone be well!
Dear residents, a general meeting will be held this Sunday at 5 pm in the club hall. We will discuss donations for water tank maintenance. Everyone is welcome to attend.
Urgent! The electrical box in block C is on fire and there is a lot of smoke. Everyone leave immediately by the stairs. Do not use the lift. Guards are on their way.
A visitor is waiting at your gate. Name: Rajesh, parcel delivery. Tap in the app to allow or deny. If there is no reply it will be denied automatically.
Sudha: The lift isn't working again 😩 / Vinod: I was stuck in it for a long time this morning, it was scary / Sudha: Did you tell the owner? / Vinod: Yes, they said a technician will come tomorrow.
Good morning everyone! May today be full of love and joy. If you send this to ten people your day will go well!
Maintenance notice: water supply will be stopped on Thursday from 10 am to 1 pm. Please store water in advance.
There is a risk of flooding in this area. Avoid low roads and go to higher ground immediately. Wait for further alerts.
Someone is at the door. The camera shows the milkman standing with a bicycle. You can check the live view. This is just a regular visit.

Murugan: Everyone bring name stickers tomorrow 😊 / Anita: Okay, my little one wants coloured paper / Murugan: I'll buy it, no problem / Anita: Thanks brother! Shall we go to the beach on Saturday? / Murugan: Definitely, at 7 am.
Share this right away: a friend said city buses will stop tonight. It is not confirmed; if anyone confirms it, let us know and share.
Local gardening meetup this Saturday at 7 am in the park. There is also a litter collection drive. Come on time and bring gloves!
Urgent: a gas leak has been found in the city. Turn off gas stoves and open the windows. Do not touch electric switches. If you must leave, follow the guard's instructions.
Your friend Vinay has arrived at the gate. Shall we allow the visit? It's a regular visit, not urgent. Tap to deny, or else wait.

Ravi: Yesterday's match was super! Our team won 🏏 / Arun: You hit the six in the last over, you were brilliant / Ravi: Ha ha, all by God's grace / Arun: Shall we play another team next week? Tell me who is coming.
